title: Serenity Skies | KEY.co
description_expanded: A newly constructed gem in the heart of Gulf Place, this luxurious retreat redefines elegance on 30A. Designed with gatherings in mind, the home’s expansive kitchen and open living spaces invite unforgettable moments of connection, whether sharing meals around the oversized island or relaxing in the spacious common areas. Multiple balconies and serene outdoor patios offer picturesque spots to soak up the Gulf breeze, while the heated pool and spa provide a private oasis for ultimate relaxation. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and style, this home blends sophistication with the laid-back charm of coastal living. You agree to not exceed the maximum number of registered guests listed on your reservation and to leave the Accommodation no later than the check-out date and time that is specified in your confirmation email, unless otherwise agreed upon in writing. If you exceed the maximum number of guests listed on your reservation without approval, Property manager is entitled to require you to vacate and remove from the Accommodation in a manner consistent with applicable law and you may be subject to additional fees.
